Theme

Latin word

officium

officium, officiī n.

noun, second declension

the staff of an office; an administrative department; a service, a good office; duty, obligation; a service owed; duty; the work one owes; a courtesy call, attendance on someone

In this lexicon

  • department

    also used · late Latin · Dig. 1.18.6; Treb. Poll. Gall. 17.8: officia palātīna (Lewis & Short)

  • favour

    also used · classical

  • obligation

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.4 (Lewis & Short); Ter. Ad. 1.1.44 (Lewis & Short: officium suum facere, “to do one’s duty”)

  • position

    also used · classical · Cic. Font. 15: mūnus atque officium (Lewis & Short)

  • visit

    also used · classical · Traupman 298

  • officium vespertīnum: vespers

    modern

Examples

  • est igitur adulēscentis majōrēs nātū verērī

    so it is the duty of the young to respect their eldersCic. Off. 1.122
